description: This file defines the EmployeeLicenseAPI class, a REST API endpoint for managing employee licenses in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, listing, adding, updating, and deleting employee license records, with extensive API documentation annotations for OpenAPI support.

classes.name: OrangeHRM\Pim\Api\EmployeeLicenseAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for managing employee licenses, supporting CRUD operations with API documentation annotations.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific employee license by employee number and license ID.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all licenses for a specific employee, with sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new employee license record.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing employee license record.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or more employee licenses by IDs.

methods.name: saveEmployeeLicense
methods.description: Helper method to instantiate and populate an EmployeeLicense entity based on request parameters.

methods.name: getEmpNumberRule
methods.description: Defines validation rule for employee number parameter.
